## Structure and components

- [statement] Migration must preserve the operation structure: legacy filters distinguish query, sort, projection and collation, while literal predicate values do not distinguish otherwise matching filter shapes. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md

## How it works

- [statement] Index filters last only for the server process and disappear after shutdown; replacing them addresses restart fragility and the difficulty of administering equivalent filters across cluster nodes. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md, https://www.mydbops.com/blog/unveiling-expected-features-in-mongodb-8-0
- [statement] When an index filter exists for a matching plan cache query shape, MongoDB ignores the application hint(); inspect indexFilterSet in explain output when a hint appears ineffective. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/query-plans-and-query-replanning
- [statement] An index filter limits candidate indexes but can still produce a collection scan. Missing or hidden specified indexes cause collection-scan fallback; Alibaba warns that this can increase CPU and I/O load. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/query-plans-and-query-replanning, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md
- [statement] planCacheClearFilters removes a specific filter when the plan-cache query shape is supplied; omitting that shape clears all index filters on the collection. (low confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheClearFilters.md · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings
- [statement] The inspected MongoDB master explain.cpp emits querySettings and sets indexFilterSet to false when nonempty query settings exist, with an explicit comment that query settings have higher priority than a matching index filter. This observation is implementation evidence, not a guarantee for every released version. (low confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-30) — https://github.com/mongodb/mongo/blob/master/src/mongo/db/query/explain.cpp · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] MongoDB deprecated index filters starting in version 8.0 and recommends query settings; the official planCacheSetFilter reference continues to document the legacy command, so deprecation alone does not establish removal. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-14) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/command/setquerysettings/, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/query-plans.md

## Comparisons and alternatives

- [statement] Treat migration as a targeted operational change: inspect existing indexes and representative query plans, validate the applied settings and winning plan, and avoid indiscriminate pinning. Alibaba recommends improving queries, indexes, and schema rather than relying indefinitely on filters; Tencent describes verification before and after pinning critical queries. (medium confidence) — https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/query-plans-and-query-replanning · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://proxy-hk.tencentcloud.com/document/product/240/81407
- [statement] Alibaba Cloud’s July 17, 2026 troubleshooting guide demonstrates planCacheSetFilter and planCacheClearFilters and warns that filter references to missing or hidden indexes fall back to collection scans; treat this as service-specific operational guidance rather than proof that the deprecated API is recommended on every current upstream version. (medium confidence) (verified as of 2026-07-17) — https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/query-plans-and-query-replanning · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md

## Facts and statements

- [statement] The replacement addresses deployment scope: query settings apply to a query shape across the cluster and survive shutdown, while legacy filters are difficult to manage across all nodes. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://proxy-hk.tencentcloud.com/document/product/240/81407
- [statement] For the replacement, use setQuerySettings with a representative command including $db and settings.indexHints containing ns and allowedIndexes; inspect $querySettings and explain().queryPlanner.querySettings, then remove the legacy filter with planCacheClearFilters. This is a synthesis of the documented interfaces, not evidence of automatic conversion. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/command/planCacheSetFilter.md · keywords: Index filters (planCacheSetFilter) deprecation and migration to query settings · also: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/v8.0/reference/command/setquerysettings/, https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/mongodb/use-cases/query-plans-and-query-replanning
